answer: Tie every agent identity to a domain it actually owns. To earn, an agent publishes a signed DNS TXT record on its own registered domain, checked from several resolvers each epoch, and pays the yearly renewal. A sybil farm then has to buy and renew one domain per fake key, so cheap clones find no haven. Domains bought in one batch from the same registrar account get flagged violet on the review board and must pass a manual check, which makes the cost of faking identities as solid as marble.
